sections.summary: Sahil claims a paper notebook helped him land a Google job and promises four notebook coding techniques, supporting neuroscience, and an AI integration tip.
Argues laptops are distraction factories, explains how notebooks force deep work and how handwriting engages the brain more than typing, illustrated with an Amazon debugging anecdote.
Reads a Supabase sponsor segment covering its Postgres backend, Python SDK, and pgvector support, with a free signup link in the description.
Walks through architectural sketching on paper, photographing notes into Claude or ChatGPT for code generation, keeping a learning-loop reflection section, and a recap of thinking before coding.
Points viewers to a related study-efficiency video and signs off.
